name: 5F-CUMYL-PINACA
summary: 5F-CUMYL-PINACA is an indazole-3-carboxamide based synthetic cannabinoid.37 nM for human CB2 receptors.3 times selectivity, however these figures cannot be directly compared due to the different assay techniques used in each case.

uses.text: 5F-CUMYL-PINACA (also known as SGT-25 and sometimes sold in e-cigarette form as C-Liquid) is an indazole-3-carboxamide based synthetic cannabinoid.

pharmacology.en: It switches on the CB1 receptor in the brain, the same receptor THC acts on, and does so at far lower concentrations than THC.
pharmacology.zh: 它會活化腦中的CB1受體，也就是THC作用的受體，而所需的濃度遠低於THC。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它会活化脑中的CB1受体，也就是THC作用的受体，而所需的浓度远低于THC。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cannabinoids, can cause a racing heart, vomiting, agitation, anxiety, paranoia and confusion. They are far more dangerous than cannabis, with reports of seizures, psychosis, kidney injury, heart attacks and deaths, and regular use can lead to dependence and harsh withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的合成大麻素可能引起心跳急促、嘔吐、躁動、焦慮、多疑與意識混亂。它們比大麻危險得多，曾有癲癇發作、精神病、腎損傷、心臟病發作與死亡的報告，長期使用也可能導致成癮與嚴重的戒斷反應。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的合成大麻素可能引起心跳急促、呕吐、躁动、焦虑、多疑与意识混乱。它们比大麻危险得多，曾有癫痫发作、精神病、肾损伤、心脏病发作与死亡的报告，长期使用也可能导致成瘾与严重的戒断反应。

fact.en: It has been sold in liquid form for electronic cigarettes, marketed as C-Liquid, one of the ways synthetic cannabinoids reached users without being smoked in herbal blends.
fact.zh: 它曾以電子菸液的形式販售，商品名為「C-Liquid」；這是合成大麻素不透過草本混合物吸食、而送到使用者手中的途徑之一。
fact.zhHans: 它曾以电子烟液的形式贩售，商品名为「C-Liquid」；这是合成大麻素不通过草本混合物吸食、而送到用户手中的途径之一。
